items.title: What Does McDonald's (MCD) New Sugar Free Lawsuit Mean For Customers And Investors?
items.summary: McDonald's (NYSE:MCD) is facing a new class-action lawsuit claiming eight McCafé drinks labeled "sugar free" actually contain sugar. The complaint, filed on behalf of a proposed nationwide class of consumers, alleges violations of federal labeling rules and state consumer laws. Plaintiffs argue the contested McCafé beverages were marketed to health conscious buyers, including people managing diabetes and other conditions.
